Молибден.about: Molybdenum is an essential trace element; There are no MAs prescribed for people in the selection: the reviews concern the status of microelements and toxic metals; dietary supplements have not been studied.
Молибден.caution: Excess micronutrients are potentially harmful; reviews note harm from excess metals - supplementation without indications is not justified.
Молибден.dosage: No data: the purpose of molybdenum in the abstracts has not been studied.
Молибден.food_sources: Legumes, grains, nuts, offal, dairy products; The content is highly dependent on the soil.
Молибден.guidelines: ESPEN 2022: trace elements are essential, deficiencies affect outcomes, monitoring is needed; reviews 2009 (hemodialysis) and 2026 - status in patients, purpose not studied.
Молибден.how_to_choose: Do not choose a supplement without indications - there is no data on effectiveness; if a deficiency is suspected, the status is assessed by a doctor.

Молибден.myths: “Microelements are equally beneficial for everyone” - the status of patients varies, there is no data. “A useful metal means an additive” - there is no evidence. “Toxic metals are only harmful” - some metals are essential, the question is the dose.
